title: Logarithmic source curves in polynomial fiber products
summary: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic zero and let $f,g\in k[x]$ be nonconstant. We study rational lifts of $f(a)$ through $g$ that do not arise from a composition $f=g\circ h$. To each non-graph component of $f(X)=g(Y)$ we attach its logarithmic source curve, namely the smooth compactification of its normalization with reduced boundary. The main geometric result is a sharp contact formula at infinity: if $N=°g/\gcd(°f,°g)$, then every one-infinity non-graph source has $X$-degree $N$, and in general the $X$-degree is $N$ times the number of boundary points.
